item.title: Greece Town Board Votes Unanimously to Revise 2026 Manager Benefits
item.description: The Greece Town Board made a new rule that town managers can’t get paid for unused sick days when they retire. Last year, paying out those sick days cost taxpayers more than $240,000. Supervisor Jeff McCann said this change will save money and be more fair. item.title: Fairport Electric Customers See Bills Jump Up to 50%
item.description: Electric bills have spiked in Fairport, with some residents paying nearly $1,000. Fairport Electric says it doesn’t set rates but delivers power, and higher state-managed market prices — driven by prolonged, severe winter cold — increased costs. Village Manager Brian White said extra power had to be purchased to meet demand, raising bills. Customers report increases of around 50%, […]
